Class
Description
AidType
The kind of help a charity association provides in the city of Cergy.
Association
A charity association operating in Cergy.
Beneficiary
A beneficiary: a person or household in need of help.
CharityMap
The central object of the application: it owns every entity (associations, centers, beneficiaries) and exposes the business operations the user interface calls.
CharityMapApp
Main entry point for the JavaFX graphical application.
CommandLineApp
The command line version of the application.
ControlPanel
Left-side control panel.
CsvImporter
Imports distribution centers from a CSV file.
DelaunayTriangulator
Builds a Delaunay triangulation of a set of points using the Bowyer-Watson incremental algorithm.
DetailsPanel
Right-side details display panel.
DistributionCenter
A physical distribution center: the main premises of an association.
GeometryUtils
A small toolbox of pure geometric computations.
GeoProjection
GPS projection calculations.
MapCanvas
Graphical Canvas component for rendering the map and handling mouse interactions.
MapIO
Saves and loads a whole CharityMap to and from a binary file, using Java serialization.
MapPainter
Helper class handling all the map rendering/drawing logic.
Point
An immutable 2D point with double precision coordinates.
RandomGenerator
Generates entities at random positions, to satisfy the "mass add with random positions" requirement of the specification.
Triangle
A triangle defined by three points, used by the Delaunay triangulation.
VoronoiBuilder
Builds Voronoi coverage zones out of a Delaunay triangulation, using the duality between the two structures.
VoronoiCell
The coverage zone of one distribution center: its Voronoi cell.
